name: ciezkowice-przewodnik
description: Przewodnik w formie aplikacji mobilnej Ciężkowice — PWA full-stack.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/client && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/client && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server
